The location of the hotel is one of its few advantages. It is easily accessible and situated in a part of the city that makes commuting relatively convenient. For travelers who need a place just to stay overnight, the location can be helpful. However, beyond this, the experience does not offer much to appreciate.

The rooms were quite disappointing. Cleanliness was not up to the mark, and there were visible signs of poor maintenance. Bedsheets and washrooms did not feel properly maintained, and the overall hygiene level could definitely be improved. Some basic amenities were either not available or not functioning properly, which made the stay uncomfortable. The furniture and interiors also appeared outdated and worn out, giving the room a neglected feel.

The service at the hotel was inconsistent. While the staff members were generally polite and tried to be helpful, the response time was slow. Simple requests took longer than expected, which suggests a lack of proper coordination or management. Better staff training and quicker service could significantly improve the guest experience.

Food quality was another area that needs attention. The menu options were limited, and the taste of the food was average at best. It did not meet expectations, especially for guests who prefer to dine within the hotel. Hygiene in the dining area could also be improved. Enhancing both the quality and variety of food would make a noticeable difference.

The overall atmosphere of the hotel feels outdated and lacks proper upkeep. The property seems to have potential, but it requires renovation and better maintenance to match even basic hospitality standards. Currently, it does not provide the comfort and quality that most travelers expect.

In conclusion, my stay at Hotel Ashish International was not very satisfying. While it may serve as a budget option for a short stay, it does not offer a pleasant or comfortable experience. I would only recommend it to those who are looking for a very basic accommodation and are willing to compromise on cleanliness and service.
